title: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!/Power Paks
text:
There are five Power Paks in the game containing unlockable items that Buzz will need to obtain certain Pizza Planet Tokens. The items are unlocked by finding a body part belonging to Mr. Potato Head and then returning it to him.

 Cosmic Shield - Gives Buzz a temporary shield to protect him from attacks and harmful substances. Buzz cannot jump very high when using the shield. This item is unlocked by finding Mr. Potato Head's ear in the Andy's House level.
Rocket Boots - Allows Buzz to temporarily run at a fast speed. This item is unlocked by finding Mr. Potato Head's arm in the Al's Toy Barn level.
Disk Launcher -  Gives Buzz a disk-like weapon necessary to defeat certain enemies. This item is unlocked by finding Mr. Potato Head's eye in the Construction Yard level.
Grappling Hook - Used to let Buzz climb areas with grapple targets. This item is unlocked by finding Mr. Potato Head's foot in the Elevator Hop level.
Hover Boots - Lets Buzz temporarily levitate and reach high up areas. This item is unlocked by finding Mr. Potato Head's mouth in the Airport Infiltration level.
